scripts.script:
Symbols ignite across the walls.

Their shapes seem to shift whenever you look directly at them. A crushing pressure settles over the strike team, slowing thought and movement alike.

The tomb is imposing its will upon the living.

Reality buckles.

Two warriors flicker out of existence and reappear where the other had been standing.

No movement. No warning.

The tomb has simply exchanged their positions.

Swap the two selected operatives on the battlefield.

A pulse rolls outward from the sarcophagus.

Nearby constructs turn almost as one, their movements suddenly precise, their weapons tracking with unnatural certainty.

Whatever sleeps within the crypt is not entirely silent.

Its will is reaching beyond the grave.

The fallen begin to move.

Emerald light returns to darkened eyes. Bodies that should lie silent rise again, driven by ancient systems that refuse to accept their destruction.

For a time, death may not be enough to stop the tombÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s defenders.

The darkness deepens.

Distant chambers seem to recede as the tomb swallows light, range and perspective alike.

Targets beyond the nearest passages become uncertain shapes in the black.

At distance, every shot becomes harder to correct.

Something is wrong.

For an instant, time fractures. Impacts seem to reverse before they fully occur. Living metal twists back toward shapes it held only moments before.

The tomb is rewriting the damage as it happens.

The damaged constructs begin to change.

Living metal flows across broken armor like liquid mercury, filling fractures and rebuilding what your weapons tore away.

Across the crypt, the tomb's wounded defenders are repairing themselves.

The chamber shudders.

Walls slide across one another with impossible precision. A route you forced open begins sealing itself while other passages grind apart elsewhere in the crypt.

The maze has changed again.

Adjust the battlefield to match the new configuration.

Something moves far below.

The vibration is almost too faint to feel, but the tomb responds immediately. Systems awaken. Signals spread. Ancient machinery begins preparing for something deeper within the complex.

The Tomb World has become more dangerous.

A mechanical chittering rises from inside the walls.

Tiny metallic forms gather in the darkness, converging on damaged machinery or spilling from seams that were empty moments before.

The scarabs are moving again.

A figure moves in the darkness.

Ancient joints unlock. Emerald light burns behind a motionless face as a warrior that has stood silent for millennia steps forward.

Another guardian has awakened.

The tomb has called it to war.
